payload.name: CaptureAllListedOptionsInMemory
payload.description: When a source message lists multiple options or alternatives (e.g., 'or', 'and', comma-separated), apply during extraction to keep all listed items in memory; do not drop items because later dialogue focuses on one.
content: During candidate extraction, if the source message explicitly enumerates two or more options/items (using 'or', 'and', commas, or slashes), include every enumerated item in the extracted memory content; do not omit one just because later messages elaborate only another.

When preparing an ADD or UPDATE, compare the proposed memory with its source evidence: if the evidence lists multiple distinct items, ensure each appears in the memory (or in another linked memory); if an existing memory omits an item from the same source, update it to add the missing item.

solves: Extraction candidates often drop one alternative from a source message when later conversation focuses on another, leaving memory incomplete. This skill enforces completeness for explicitly enumerated options/lists in a single message, across topics. It applies during extraction and CRUD whenever a statement lists multiple items; it does not apply to single-item statements or to inferences beyond the evidence.
